name: client-resource-access-action-negative-test-1519220005/client-resource-access-return-type-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed, but object-constructor expressions are not listed.
Other invocation restrictions: "Client resource access actions require an atomic client receiver. Dispatch is not supported when more than one resource method matches the access path."
reason: The case creates its receiver using an anonymous client object constructor (`var successClient = client object { ... };`), an expression form not covered by the supported Expressions list. Support for object/class members and client resource access actions does not establish support for constructing this anonymous object. This essential setup makes the whole case a feature gap even though its asserted argument/return type errors concern supported client resource actions.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous client object constructor expression `client object { ... }`.
test_design_notes: The case asserts compile-time rejection through @error markers for incompatible resource arguments and result assignments; it has no @args, @panic, or @output assertions.
The receiver has distinct literal resource paths and a single inferred client type; the atomic-receiver and unique-resource-match restrictions do not independently exclude these accesses.
